title: Fix replay selection through symlinked input paths
body:
## Summary

A replay dependency declared as `alias/dep.json`, with `alias -> src`, can pass file validation yet select no replay when Git reports a change to `src/dep.json`.

```diff
 declared dependency
-  accept an in-repository directory symlink
-  compare its alias with Git changed paths
+  reject existing symlink components during validation and planning
+  retain missing inputs so deletion still selects the consumer
```

The shared guard propagates permission and I/O failures. The scoped package retains the exact historical source, a rerunnable counterexample, provenance, affected-input declarations and open next questions. This is a declared `portable-replay` scope change under priority revision 5. Coordination: [discussion 2983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2983).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the SHA256/Git-blob-authenticated main `f1de0c136a6d897332c63eb00b02bcc15e696b31` runner accepts the parent alias and returns `[]` after the target changes.
  **After:** both boundaries reject it; a canonical target-only Git commit selects exactly its consumer; deleting its directory still selects that consumer.
- Registered package replay passes: `uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/replay-input-symlink-alias`. Includes the baseline reproducer, nine new behavioral groups and five retained lexical-path groups.
- Research tooling suite: 167 tests pass, 18 platform-specific skips, CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64. The nine new groups also pass under optimized CPython 3.14.8. Real permission and Git/CLI fixtures run without skips; CLI failures publish no partial matrix.
- Source/metadata checks, warnings-as-errors compilation and diff checks pass. Internal automated review found no remaining defects after strengthening the positive CLI control. No independent human review is claimed.

The final widened overlap scan found [@EdDiboi's earlier local-only handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18942018) on the same gap. This independently corroborates that report and provides a public source-bound patch; no new-discovery or reuse of unavailable code is claimed. The stated prior claim expired. Final overlap covered 230 open PRs, 1,687 discussion records and 2,440 closed PRs with complete pagination, within documented search limits. Refreshed canonical main `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455` leaves the relevant guidance, selected record and inputs unchanged.

Credit woklerx/PR1891 for the lexical guard, Charles Bethin for replay-selection controls, Douglas Colkitt for the runner/scaffold, and Nick Petalas/PR2958 for the separate inventory repair. Substantial AI assistance was used in investigation, implementation, tests and writing.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** replay-selection

The shared runner rejects previously accepted symlinked dependency paths. Contributors must declare the target path. Its change selects all registered packages through the existing workflow policy. Stable checkouts are required; concurrent writers, case-insensitive aliases, hard links and Windows reparse points are outside scope. No hosted cross-platform result, cold supplier replay, new supplier or kappa is claimed. The selected frontier and frozen evidence remain unchanged.
